title: "Love Thy Neighbor" Cookbook Launch
description: We are excited to announce the upcoming launch of the Ojai Interfaith Council cookbook — a celebration of the diverse culinary traditions and shared table of our faith communities. Details coming soon!

title: International Day of Peace
description: Join us in Libbey Park to celebrate the United Nations' International Day of Peace — a time for communities of all faiths to come together in reflection, prayer, and shared commitment to peace.

title: Interfaith Thanksgiving Service
description: Our annual Thanksgiving service brings together voices from across Ojai's faith communities in gratitude and fellowship. All are warmly welcome.

title: Council Monthly Meeting
location: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
description: The Council meets on the second Thursday of each month. Community members are welcome to attend and share.
